candidates.excerpt: The court has no authority to meet a delegation of any political party at the administrative level in this way, and its power is in fact to hear the petition and give a verdict, the CJI is learnt to have said.

candidates.title: Permanent house titles distributed to 939 families in Nellore
candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu launches the programme virtually from his camp office; beneficiaries, most of whom are women, describe it as early Dasara gift; house titles for 4,000 poor families soon, says Collector

candidates.title: Did Abhijeet Dipke refuse to call his father after grandmother's death? New video counters CJP leader's claim | Watch
candidates.excerpt: Abhijeet Dipke and Delhi Police have offered conflicting accounts of whether officers let him call family after his grandmother died. Dipke said he was denied phone and lawyer access while police said he declined calls and travel help.

candidates.title: Poland's police warn of a possible plot to attack Prime Minister Donald Tusk
candidates.excerpt: Security services, police, and representatives of the Interior Ministry were scheduled to hold an emergency meeting at 11 am (0900 GMT) on October 11 to discuss the situation, Karolina Galecka, says Interior Ministry spokesperson
